messages.subject: shiny server connection
parts:
Hi I ma new with shiny-server.

I  installed shiny server based on the instruction on the github site and got the following message after running the command

sudo start shiny-server

asking for a password. the root doesn't work. Do you know which one I should enter?

tks

Christophe

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny server connection
parts: Just your regular Unix password (assuming your user is a sudoer). The other option would be to run "su" alone, type in the root password, and then run "start shiny-server".
